user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking where check-in and check-out are the same date to be rejected so that same-day bookings are not allowed.

positive.title: Successfully create a booking with different check-in and check-out dates
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest
Select a check-out date that is after the check-in date
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully created with the specified check-in and check-out dates.

negative.title: Reject booking with check-in and check-out on the same date
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest
Select the same date for check-out
negative.expected_result: The booking is rejected with an error message indicating that same-day bookings are not allowed.

edge.title: Attempt booking with a check-out date one day after check-in
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest
Select a check-out date that is one day after the check-in date
edge.expected_result: The booking is successfully created with the specified check-in and next day check-out dates.
